children: AleAnna Inc. (ANNA) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on November 12, 2026.

On November 9, 2026, the Board of Directors (the "Board") of the Company increased the size of the Board from five directors to six directors and filled the newly created vacancy by appointing Glen Cayley to the Board to serve as a Class III director for a term expiring at the Company's 2027 annual meeting of stockholders and until his successor is duly elected and qualified or until his earlier death, resignation, or removal. Mr. Cayley was also appointed to serve as a member of the Audit Committee of the Board and the Compensation Committee of the Board.

Glen Cayley, 71, is an upstream oil and gas professional with 40 years of experience leading exploration, field development and production operations worldwide. Since June 2024, Mr. Cayley has served as a director and Co-Founder of Azuli Limited, a United Kingdom developer of carbon capture and storage projects. Since December 2023, Mr. Cayley has served as the Executive Chairman and Co-Founder of Azuli International Limited. Since April 2023, Mr. Cayley has also served as a member of the board of directors of Round Down Residents Garden Company Limited. Since July 2017, Mr. Cayley has served as a member of the board of directors of Cayley Oil and Gas Advisory. Between 2010 and 2017, Mr. Cayley held a series of senior roles at Shell EP and Royal Dutch Shell plc., including Vice President of Exploration Excellence, Chief Explorer and the UK and Ireland Upstream Director. Mr. Cayley holds a B.Sc. in Geology/Earth Science and Chemistry from the University of Liverpool and an M.Sc. in Petroleum Geology from the University of Aberdeen.
The Company believes Mr. Cayley is qualified to serve as a director of the Company due to his extensive experience in upstream oil and gas exploration, development and operations.

Mr. Cayley will receive the Company's standard compensation for non-employee directors, which is described in the Company's definitive proxy statement on Schedule 14A filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on April 30, 2026. There are no arrangements or understandings between Mr. Cayley and any other person pursuant to which Mr. Cayley was named a director of the Company.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1845123/000184512326000004/anna-20261109.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1845123/000184512326000004/0001845123-26-000004-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
